اعتمدن (form VIII)
# اِعْتَمَدْنَ (iʕtamadna) /iʕ.ta.mad.na/: third-person feminine plural past active of اِعْتَمَدَ (iʕtamada)
# اُعْتُمِدْنَ (uʕtumidna) /uʕ.tu.mid.na/: third-person feminine plural past passive of اِعْتَمَدَ (iʕtamada)
# اِعْتَمِدْنَ (iʕtamidna) /iʕ.ta.mid.na/: second-person feminine plural imperative of اِعْتَمَدَ (iʕtamada)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
